title: Las Vegas Night Flight Helicopter Wedding Ceremony
includes: Private helicopter wedding party for up to 5 people
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Individual passenger weights MUST be advised at the time of booking
Due to comfort and weight / balance of the aircraft, there is a weight limit of 250 Lbs (112 kg / 17.9 stones) per seat. Another seat is required for more than 250lbs.
The minister flies in the same helicopter as the wedding party
Bookings may have up to 3 additional guests
Photo and video packages are available for purchase. In this case, only 2 additional guests may be in the helicopter.
You may choose from the following colors for your flowers: white, pink, peach or red.
Civil ceremonies are available upon request
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience a truly unforgettable wedding in Las Vegas as you exchange vows high above the city’s sparkling lights in a private, luxury helicopter. This exclusive aerial ceremony offers breathtaking views of the iconic Las Vegas Strip, creating an atmosphere of excitement and romance. Make your special day extraordinary with a unique celebration that blends adventure, elegance, and lasting memories for you and your guests.
